## 页间 v0.1.24

- **Windows** — `yejian-v0.1.24-windows-x64.exe`，x64 安装包。
- **Android** — `yejian-v0.1.24-android.apk`，沿用正式签名的通用安装包。已安装正式版的用户可覆盖升级。旧调试版用户请先导出书库备份，再按[迁移步骤](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/v0.1.21)操作。

### macOS / Linux 测试包 / Test downloads

这四个文件可免登录下载，也可以查看[桌面测试版的附件和安装说明](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/desktop-test-v0.1.24)。

- **macOS** — [Apple Silicon DMG](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/download/desktop-test-v0.1.24/yejian-v0.1.24-macos-test-arm64.dmg) · [Intel DMG](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/download/desktop-test-v0.1.24/yejian-v0.1.24-macos-test-x64.dmg)
- **Linux x64** — [AppImage](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/download/desktop-test-v0.1.24/yejian-v0.1.24-linux-test-x86_64.AppImage) · [`.deb` (Debian / Ubuntu)](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/download/desktop-test-v0.1.24/yejian-v0.1.24-linux-test-amd64.deb)

### English

The stable release includes the Windows x64 installer and the release-signed universal Android APK. If you are migrating from an Android debug build, export a library backup and follow the [migration guide](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/v0.1.21). See the [desktop pre-release](https://github.com/itcwc/yejian-reader/releases/tag/desktop-test-v0.1.24) for macOS and Linux installation instructions.
